item.title: The US economy lost 92,000 jobs in February and the unemployment rate rose to 4.4%
item.description: US businesses unexpectedly shed 92,000 jobs in February, resulting in an unemployment rate of 4.4%, due to a combination of factors including a labor strike, cold weather, and a new war in the Middle East. item.title: The 2026 African Film Festival Atlanta Announces Its Official Film Selections and Ticket Sales
item.description: The African Film Festival Atlanta (AFFATL) has announced its official film selection and ticket sales for its 5th edition, taking place from March 26th - 20th, 2026, featuring 32 films from 12 countries and highlighting the power of African storytelling in a digital, globalized world. item.title: NBA scraps Atlanta Hawks’ ‘Magic City Monday’ event
item.description: The NBA has cancelled the Atlanta Hawks' "Magic City Monday" event due to concerns from league stakeholders, including fans and employees, about the promotion of Atlanta's premier strip club.
